title: incident-bot: add SLO toolkit on-call helpers + automated diagnostics integration
author: Lena Kirov
description:
Motivation: On-call engineers need faster context and one-click diagnostic helpers when SLO alerts fire. This PR wires the slo-toolkit utilities into incident-bot, exposing on-call helper actions (runbook quicklinks, trace retrieval, automated diagnostics kickoffs) and adds lightweight telemetry and integration tests.

What I changed:
- Add `slo_toolkit.oncall_helpers` adapter used by incident-bot when a SLO alert is detected; provides prioritized runbook quicklinks, suggested diagnostics, and templated commands for common remediation steps.
- Implement `diagnostics.kickoff` action that schedules an automated diagnostics run and links results back to the incident thread. This uses the existing autodiagnostics service with a small compatibility shim.
- Add per-incident caching for quicklinks to avoid repeated upstream lookups and reduce rate against the runbook index.
- Instrumentation: add lightweight metrics and tracing spans around helper generation and diagnostics kickoff (metric names: incidentbot.oncall.helpers.latency, incidentbot.autodx.requests).
- Tests: unit tests for helper prioritization heuristics, + an integration test that simulates SLO alert flow through incident-bot -> slo-toolkit -> autodiagnostics and asserts a runbook quicklink and diagnostics attachment appear in the thread.
- Docs: update incident-bot runbook to document new actions, usage examples, and required Linear keys/permissions.

Checklist:
- [x] Add adapter and action handlers
- [x] Unit tests for heuristics and caching
- [x] Integration test for end-to-end flow
- [x] Telemetry and CI coverage
- [x] Docs and Linear links added

Risks/Notes: The diagnostics kickoff is gated behind a feature flag `autodx_oncall_kickoff` and limited to users in the oncall group to avoid accidental noisy runs. Backwards compatible fallbacks included: if slo-toolkit returns no runbooks we surface a helpful message and a direct link to the runbook index.

Related: Linear ENG-2145, ENG-3220, PM-87.
commit_summary: 3 commits: add oncall helpers adapter; integrate autodiagnostics kickoff action; add tests + docs
review_comments: Ava Chen: Please gate the autodx kickoff behind a feature flag and ensure only oncall group members can trigger (resolved: added feature flag and group check).
Diego Martinez: Can we reduce the number of external requests when generating quicklinks? Observed potential N+1 against the runbook index (resolved: added caching per-incident).
Priya Nair: Add e2e test simulating SLO alert flow and verify metrics emitted (resolved: added integration test and metric assertions).
Lena Kirov: replied to comments and addressed changes; added docs and feature flag defaults.
release_notes: Add on-call helper actions in incident-bot: runbook quicklinks, automated diagnostics kickoff, and lightweight telemetry. Feature is behind `autodx_oncall_kickoff`.
